evidence.claim: Bank upstream fraud detection model flagged transaction with high risk score of 0.79.
Cardholder denied authorizing the transaction and confirmed card remains in physical possession.

case.summary: Confirmed card_not_present_fraud episode totaling $292.36. Circumstantial or sparse signals; uncertainty exceeds threshold (0.45), requesting secondary validation.

evidence_requests.assumed_response: Customer states they did not make these purchases and still has the physical card.

initial.reason: High model risk score (>= 0.70); decline pending authorization
R1: require step-up authentication before blocking card

final.reason: R2: customer denied unauthorized use; block card (exposure <= $2,500)
R2: create internal fraud case with evidence attached and persist to graph

next_best_actions.what_changed: Customer denial confirmed fraud, upgrading action from verification to permanent card block and SAR filing.

stop_reason: Customer denial confirmed fraud; pattern and network links identified. Further steps would not change action.
